messages:
maya: Quick UI question — when sampling is toggled off and I drag the time range scrubber, the heatmap 'ghosts' (old buckets stay visible for ~200ms) and the p95 tooltip jumps to the top-left. Repro: Sampling -> Off, 1h range, scrub. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/heatmap-ghost.png. First saw on staging.

jon: I can repro. Also noticed keyboard nav loses focus when the scrubber snaps to the nearest bucket. Focus outline disappears.

kevin: Sounds like our sampler debounce is canceling a render and we remount the bucket layer. Virtualized bucket list re-mounts cause DOM nodes to shift. I can investigate the virtualization lifecycle.

maya: UX question — what should "Sampling: Off" mean visually? Show raw buckets (which can be noisy) or collapse to coarser aggregated buckets? Users are getting confused by the jumps.

sara: Product preference: OFF = deterministic full-data view (no approximation), but we must avoid visual layout jumps. If rendering takes >100ms show a placeholder, not jump.

ava: Accessibility notes: when focus moves, screen reader reads silence. We need an aria-live region announcing p95 changes and keep a visible focus ring when scrubber snaps. Keyboard scrubbing should announce step size and current range.

jon: Quick fix idea: keep the scrubber and bucket container mounted (sticky DOM) and animate opacity of incoming/outgoing buckets instead of removing nodes. Also throttle tooltip repositioning (e.g., 80ms) so it doesn't teleport. Small patch.

kevin: I like sticky DOM + opacity fade. Should be low-risk. I'll try to avoid changing the virtualization logic for now. Also will attach aria-live updates for p95 text.

maya: Microcopy proposal for the sampling control: change label to 'Sampling: On (approximate)' and 'Sampling: Off (exact)'. Hover tooltip: 'Sampling reduces compute for large ranges; may show approximate percentiles.'

sara: That wording seems fine. Make the hover tooltip explicit about tradeoffs.

ava: For a11y: don't use parentheses only — screen readers prefer the word 'approximate' spelled out. Also add keyboard-accessible help: focus the toggle and pressing '?' opens more info.

layout-bot: Deploy preview created: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2165001234 (preview includes opacity fade + aria-live).

jon: Patch: https://gist.github.com/redwood/pr-heatmap-fade — implements CSS transition on .bucket and adds aria-live div with id 'heatmap-announcements'.

kevin: Deployed the patch to staging. Repro now: ghosting eliminated, tooltip movement is smoother, NVDA reads p95 updates and focus outline persists. Please regression test.

maya: Verified on mac VoiceOver + Chrome. One nit: change microcopy from 'approx.' to full 'approximate' per Ava. Also the tooltip link to docs should be keyboard reachable.

sara: Good to ship as a minor UX + a11y patch. Add a single-line changelog entry: 'Heatmap: reduce layout jumps when toggling sampling; improve p95 announce for screen readers.'

maya: I'll add that to the release notes and the console copy PR. Thanks all. :tada:
